prompt: A prime-time adult animated sitcom background: flat colours and slightly wobbly black outlines, every colour laid on with thick visible oil brushstrokes. Looking straight down from high above onto a crossroads of two narrow 1930s American streets at night: four blocks of flat rooftops and soot-black brick fill the corners, wet cobbles form the cross between them. A police car stopped at the junction throws red and blue up the walls. In a puddle in one of the streets, the only sign of the sky: the reflection of a small, perfectly round, solid red moon. One window glows candle yellow. Plain margins with no writing. Thanks.
